label: Boxes from points
subgoals: Take the minimum and maximum x over the points
Take the minimum and maximum y over the points
Combine the two extents into a half-perimeter or an area

label: Intersecting two rectangles
subgoals: Take the larger of the left edges and the smaller of the right edges
Do the same for bottom and top edges
Multiply the two overlaps when both are positive

label: Edge cases and many rectangles
subgoals: Classify zero overlaps as touching, not overlapping
Intersect several boxes by taking the extreme edges
Report zero area whenever an extent is not positive
